name: madrasha
description: Root runner for Madrasha backend + frontend (dev convenience only)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,LANDING,ADMIN,SUPER-ADMIN -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:landing --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:admin --prefix frontend" "npm run dev:super-admin --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
